decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewithApplication Letter, Flood Risk Assessment, Drawing Numbers BPB/0854, 102/02, 885/01, Planning/Heritage/Design and Access Statement, received 27/05/12.
Drawing Number 885/02B received 11/06/12
 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted, including a sample mortar and brick panel and a photograph of a sample area of removed render/cleaned brickwork, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Works to a Listed Building. Erection of a front boundary wall including rebuilding of existing brick pier & ball finial. Removal of render to the house, brickwork cleaning and external repairs. Installation of a timber balustrade to the rear roof terrace. Erection of a side wall with a gate across the side passage. Window repairs, including draught-proofing. Alterations to existing rear roof extension and further roof extension to the rear of the house.
